newsitem.title: USA: Western Resources unit begins Turkey project.
newsitem.headline: Western Resources unit begins Turkey project.

text.p: Western Resources Inc said its Wing Group subsidiary has begun construction with its partners of a 478 megawatt combined-cycle power project in Marmara, Turkey.

It said the estimated total project cost is about $600 million. The Houston, Texas-based Wing Group, acquired earlier this year by Western Resources, is a developer of large international power generation projects.
In the Marmara project, Wing Group is partnered with Enron Corp, Midlands Electricity Plc MEB.L of the United Kingdom and GAMA Industries of Turkey.

Commercial operation of the Marmara project is expected to begin in September 1999. The natural-gas fired plant will provide power to the state power utility, Turkiye Elektrik Uretim, Iletim A.S., under a 20-year power purchase agreement.
